title: indigofera trita var. scabra
intro: Indigofera trita var. scabra, commonly known as the rough-leaved indigo, is a species of plant in the pea family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Indigofera trita var. scabra include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
